symbols.name: sequence term
symbols.meaning: The $k$-th term of a sequence of real numbers.
symbols.quote: Let $\chi_1, \chi_2, \chi_3, \dots$ be a sequence of real numbers, where $\chi_k$ is the $k$-th term.

symbols.name: term index
symbols.meaning: The position of a term in a sequence, an index counting from 1.
symbols.quote: Here $k$ and $m$ are position indices on this page.

symbols.name: tail start position
symbols.meaning: The position from which the tail of a sequence starts.
symbols.quote: Here $k$ and $m$ are position indices on this page.

symbols.name: tail infimum
symbols.meaning: The infimum of the terms from position $m$ on, the largest number at most all of them.
symbols.quote: For each position $m$, let $\tau_m$ be the infimum of the terms from position $m$ on: the largest number that is at most every term $\chi_k$ with $k \ge m$.

symbols.name: positive tolerance
symbols.meaning: A positive real number used as a tolerance in a limit criterion.
symbols.quote: let $\varepsilon$ be a positive real tolerance.

symbols.name: worst-case time
symbols.meaning: The worst-case running time of machine $A$ on inputs of $n$ bits.
symbols.quote: For a fixed machine $A$, $\mathcal{T}_A(n)$ is the worst-case running time of $A$ on inputs of $n$ bits.

symbols.name: lower-bound constant
symbols.meaning: A positive real constant in the lower bound for machine $A$.
symbols.quote: Here $\delta_A > 0$ is a real constant and $\Gamma_A$ is a threshold on input length.

symbols.name: input length threshold
symbols.meaning: The input length beyond which the lower bound for machine $A$ is required to hold.
symbols.quote: Here $\delta_A > 0$ is a real constant and $\Gamma_A$ is a threshold on input length.

symbols.name: bound exponent
symbols.meaning: The fixed exponent $2^{-182}$ in the main time bound.
symbols.quote: Here $\kappa = 2^{-182}$ is a fixed exponent with $0 < \kappa < 1$, and $C$ is a constant

symbols.name: bound constant
symbols.meaning: A constant in the big-O time bound of the main result.
symbols.quote: Here $\kappa = 2^{-182}$ is a fixed exponent with $0 < \kappa < 1$, and $C$ is a constant

relations.predicate: is applied to the ratio of
relations.quote: The limit inferior is applied to the ratio of time to the [Schönhage–Strassen bound](schonhage-strassen.md) $n\lg n$, that is, to $\mathcal{T}_A(n)/(n\lg n)$.
The limit inferior takes its values in the [extended real numbers](extended-reals.md), and it is $-\infty$ when the terms are unbounded below.
